cd /workspace && cat > tmp/test_min2.py << 'PYEOF'
import random,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import main as M
def naive(n,A,tr,acc):
    block=[1 if acc[s] else 0 for s in range(n)]
    while True:
        sig={}; nb=[0]*n; k=0
        for s in range(n):
            key=(block[s],tuple(block[tr[s][c]] for c in range(A)))
            if key not in sig: sig[key]=k; k+=1
            nb[s]=sig[key]
        if nb==block: break
        block=nb
    return sorted(frozenset(s for s in range(n) if block[s]==b) for b in set(block))
random.seed(2024)
for t in range(2000):
    n=random.randint(1,40); A=random.randint(0,5)
    tr=[[random.randrange(n) for _ in range(A)] for _ in range(n)]
    acc=[random.random()<0.5 for _ in range(n)]
    blocks,bo=M.hopcroft(n,A,tr,acc)
    hp=sorted(frozenset(v) for v in blocks.values())
    np=naive(n,A,tr,acc)
    if hp!=np:
        print("MISMATCH",t,n,A); sys.exit(1)
print("hopcroft matches naive on larger random DFAs")
PYEOF
